events.empty: Nothing planned for the next 7 days

week.up: {{value}} points more than the week before
week.down: {{value}} points less than the week before
week.tableCaption: Habits completed and tasks finished on each of the last seven days
week.explanation: Bars show the share of habits due that day that were completed. Skipped and postponed habits are not counted.

insights.empty: Insights appear as you use Personalitify

all_habits_done.text: Every habit due today is done.
all_habits_done.rule: All habits due today are completed. Skipped and postponed ones are not counted.

overdue_tasks.text: {{count}} open tasks are past their due date.
overdue_tasks.rule: Open tasks whose due date is before today.

goal_deadline.text: "{{title}}" is due in {{days}} days and is at {{percent}}%.
goal_deadline.rule: The active goal whose target date is closest, when it is within the next 7 days.

habit_rate_up.text: You completed {{current}}% of your due habits this week, up from {{previous}}%.
habit_rate_up.rule: Completed out of due habits in the last 7 days compared with the 7 days before. Shown when the difference is at least 5 points.

habit_rate_down.text: You completed {{current}}% of your due habits this week, compared with {{previous}}% the week before.
habit_rate_down.rule: Completed out of due habits in the last 7 days compared with the 7 days before. Shown when the difference is at least 5 points.

streak_goal_near.text: {{name}}: {{remaining}} more to reach your streak goal of {{goal}}.
streak_goal_near.rule: A habit whose current streak is within 3 of the streak goal you set.

long_streak.text: {{name}} has been kept {{count}} days in a row.
long_streak.rule: Your longest current streak, once it is 7 days or longer.

busy_day.rule: The day in the next 7 days with the most timed events and task blocks, when there are 3 or more.

activity.empty: What you do will be listed here

customize.title: Customize dashboard
customize.description: Choose what you see and in which order. The layout is saved to your account.

allHidden.title: Every widget is hidden
allHidden.description: Choose the widgets you want to see on your dashboard.
